registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Form is active.

minimal.title: Show a follow-up question for one answer
minimal.description: The follow-up appears only when the radio answer is "Yes".

syntheticIds.formId: A UUID identifying this form within the post (submissions are grouped by it). Generate a fresh UUID (v4) per Fair Form block; the editor replaces a missing or duplicated one.

ticket-type.title: Signup questions for one ticket type
ticket-type.description: Inside Event Signup: asks for a student ID only when the visitor picks a given ticket type.

syntheticIds.conditionTicketTypeIds: Ticket type IDs of the event the signup belongs to (Fair Events → event → Prices tab). With IDs that do not belong to the event the section never shows.

event-option.title: Questions for an event option
event-option.description: Inside Event Signup: shows a menu choice only when the "dinner" option is selected.
